name: Elon Musk Saves Britain
detailed_description:
In this 2D platformer, Elon Musk is the superhero on a mission to save the UK from the tyranny of Prime Minister, Keir Starmer, and restore the right of Britons to free speech. As if that wasn't enough, Earth is being invaded by aliens who are hellbent on changing our way of life!

You are armed only with 'Free Speech' and 'Truth' projectiles, plus the love in your heart (the only antidote to the hateful aliens) and, of course, a stick for spanking!

In the time-honored way of (almost) all 2D platformers ever made, you must dodge bullets, jump across perilous gaps, avoid various hazards, shoot the aliens and collect coins (10 per level).

Make Britain great again!

content_descriptors.notes: The game deals with governmental corruption, political cover-ups and the escalating assault on free speech in the UK. The true reason for restricting free speech (which is not related to public safety as per the cover-story) is explored and exposed. There is frequent swearing (to be expected from politicians) and minor nudity (buttocks) and a penis, plus a framed picture of penises. The impact of religious ideology is unapologetically held up for scrutiny. Political correctness is satirized and the politicians who shamelessly support it are ridiculed. This is not a game for the easily offended. It may pique the interest of Keir Starmer's stormtroopers  (the British thought-crime police). There are references to sexual assault, violence toward women and suicide.
